stemMd: Which statement must be true in every permitted order?

options.label: D
options.textMd: Brief must not be in position 1.

explanationMd:
Combine the ordering and placement constraints rather than assuming one example is unique. The statement "Guide must precede Summary." holds in all 7 permitted orders. Generate the cases by placing any fixed-position item and adjacent block first, then discard arrangements that violate a remaining rule. For each alternative, an explicit permitted counterexample appears in its feedback.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Brief → Demo → Guide → Summary → Interview
- Brief → Demo → Interview → Guide → Summary
- Brief → Guide → Summary → Interview → Demo
- Brief → Interview → Demo → Guide → Summary
- Guide → Summary → Brief → Demo → Interview
- Guide → Summary → Brief → Interview → Demo
- Guide → Summary → Interview → Brief → Demo

distractorRationale.d: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Brief → Demo → Guide → Summary → Interview. Thus this statement is not necessary.
distractorRationale.a: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Brief → Demo → Guide → Summary → Interview. Thus this statement is not necessary.
distractorRationale.c: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Guide → Summary → Brief → Demo → Interview. Thus this statement is not necessary.

Demo and Summary must not occupy consecutive positions. leave 7 valid orders: Brief>Demo>Guide>Summary>Interview; Brief>Demo>Interview>Guide>Summary; Brief>Guide>Summary>Interview>Demo; Brief>Interview>Demo>Guide>Summary; Guide>Summary>Brief>Demo>Interview; Guide>Summary>Brief>Interview>Demo; Guide>Summary>Interview>Brief>Demo.
